query: Is there a critical window of adaptation depth beyond which removal produces irreversible neural strategy changes that permanently alter the trust baseline?

results.title: 7.5: Sensitive and Critical Periods of Development
results.snippet: Sensitive and critical periods both involve heightened neuroplasticity. Sensitive periods offer broad windows for experience to shape neural circuitry, while critical periods are a subset that can result in irreversible changes to the brain (Knudsen, 2004).
